children: UK investment firm's half-year revenue fell yr/yr, impacted by lower volumes at Shire Foods
Profit before tax and net income declined compared to prior year period
Company maintained strong liquidity and net assets increased yr/yr
Volvere expects Shire Foods' 2027 revenue to grow over 2026 and 2025 levels
Company expects Shire Foods to achieve year-on-year profitable growth in 2027
Volvere is adopting a cautious approach to investment decisions amid UK and global uncertainty

REDUCED VOLUMES - Co said lower volumes at Shire Foods, including loss of low-margin foodservice product and reduced sales of value products to a large retail customer, drove revenue and profit decline
HIGHER COSTS - Co said increased costs for raw materials, labour, distribution and food waste disposal weighed on profitability
INVENTORY BUILD - Co increased beef inventory to protect margins and ensure supply amid high oil prices
